rootCause: all ten storyteller clones are Rust/eframe apps: at launch they call setApplicationIconImage with artwork embedded in the executable, so the Dock flipped to the original clone icon while running no matter what the bundle .icns said. Verified by reading the running Dock tile (green chameleon) against the bundle icon (Figma logo).

runtimeIconFix.method: full skins scan the executable for PNG streams that pixel-match the app's original bundle icon and replace exactly those bytes (same total length, zero-padded; no other offset moves), then ad-hoc re-sign as before. Original bytes are stored with the full-skin backup (exec-patch-*.bin) and restored byte-exactly on unskin; restore round-trip is unit-tested including fingerprint equality.
runtimeIconFix.detection: conservative: only square embedded PNGs >=64px whose pixels match the original bundle icon are touched; a synthetic test proves unrelated embedded images are never patched, and a replacement that cannot fit its byte slot is never forced.
runtimeIconFix.matchingFix: icon comparison shrinks by progressive halving after a detailed engraving-style icon (Figma's chameleon) aliased under single-step point sampling (Go mean diff 14.0 vs 0.9 area-averaged) and was first reported unpatchable; regression-tested with synthetic detailed artwork.
runtimeIconFix.verdictGuard: re-checking an already-patched app keeps the 'patched' verdict (the embedded art no longer matches the original because it was replaced); inspection is versioned (ExecIconCheck) so improved matching re-checks old verdicts.

squircleFix: full-bleed publisher/App Store artwork fitted to the macOS grid is now also clipped to a superellipse (exponent 5) with antialiased edge — macOS does not round square artwork itself. Measured on migrated bundles: 512px rendition corner alpha 0, edge-midpoint alpha 255, bbox (50,50)-(462,462); embedded runtime icons likewise (256px corner alpha 0).
